Oil changes are not covered. Overpaying for them is optional.

Your plan covers the expensive surprises, not the scheduled stuff. The scheduled stuff is where Openbay+ earns its keep: book an ASE-certified shop, see the price up front, member discount off at the counter.
You were at {{{MILEAGE}}} when you bought the plan. If you are close to an oil change, book it now and keep the receipt. Service records are what a claims adjuster asks for first, and a folder of Openbay receipts answers the question before it is asked.

THE HABIT
Book: Openbay+, member pricing
Keep: Every receipt, in one folder or one email label
Why: Maintenance records support covered claims
Bonus: The {{{VEHICLE}}} lasts longer. Shocking, we know.

Keeping records is the least glamorous advice in car ownership and the most useful. A plan pays for covered failures on a maintained car. Openbay makes the maintained part cheap and the records part automatic.
